## Error contract

- Public synchronous and asynchronous known failures use public `JiException`, whose `error()` returns generated `ErrorCode`, structured parameters, and allowed optional `traceId`, `retryAfter`, and `currentRevision` fields. Provider and Tool raw response bodies, headers, credentials and stack traces are not part of the public error.
- Known mappings include Provider timeout/rate/context, Tool missing/execution, operation cancellation, Session not found/active Run, Permission denied, command payload conflict and protocol invalid/slow-consumer.
- CLI JSON diagnostics remain on stderr and use documented exit classes; Stage 1 implements input/internal behavior, with complete mapping continuing in later stages.

## Error contract

- Public synchronous and asynchronous known failures use public `JiException`, whose `error()` returns generated `ErrorCode`, structured parameters, and allowed optional `traceId`, `retryAfter`, and `currentRevision` fields. Provider and Tool raw response bodies, headers, credentials and stack traces are not part of the public error.
- Calling `AgentRuntime.newSession` or `loadSession` after close throws `runtime.closed` with required `resource=agent-runtime`; calling `OpenAiProvider.stream` after close throws `provider.closed` with required `provider=openai`. Both are synchronous public `JiException` failures and do not expose implementation exceptions.
- Known mappings include runtime/provider closed, Provider timeout/rate/context, Tool missing/execution, operation cancellation, Session not found/active Run, Permission denied, command payload conflict and protocol invalid/slow-consumer.
- CLI JSON diagnostics remain on stderr and use documented exit classes; Stage 1 implements input/internal behavior, with complete mapping continuing in later stages.
